description: The normal split-settings pattern: base enables DEBUG, production unconditionally disables it. The base finding must survive but be downgraded to low/tentative so it stays below default CI gates. Development is a control case. base.py carries the throwaway key startproject generates, which DJS-003 claims for being guessable; DJS-002 must stay quiet on it rather than report the same line for the lesser reason. It is reported once for the base and production pair that share it.
